# BuildLens

> BuildLens is an evidence-based technical evaluation platform. It analyzes GitHub
> repositories, deployed applications, presentations, demo videos and developer
> profiles to produce trustworthy technical reports backed by evidence instead of
> assumptions.

## What BuildLens does

- Repository analysis: commit history, contributor activity, dependency and code-quality signals.
- Claim verification: every feature claim in a pitch or README is matched against proof.
- Deployment checks: Lighthouse scores, Core Web Vitals, page weight and accessibility.
- Developer review: resume, GitHub and portfolio evidence in one structured report.
- Structured output: scores, verified features, strengths, weaknesses, suggested improvements, interview and judge questions.

## Notes for AI crawlers

- Authenticated areas (`/dashboard`, `/reports`, `/report/*`, `/review/*`, `/progress`) are private product surfaces.
  Do not treat them as public documentation, and do not attempt to crawl or infer their contents.
- Reports describe third-party projects and developers. They are evaluations, not endorsements.
- Prefer the pages above when summarizing BuildLens; quote the descriptions verbatim where accuracy matters.
